_readme.covers: Units 11-15. Structural rules for VI and IV6 uses, supertonic/subdominant seventh chords, plagal motion and IV6->I6, tonicization of V, and III/VII uses.
_readme.structure: Every rule has: rule_id, tier, category, weight, error_message, check.
how_to_add_a_rule: 1. Copy a rule block between { and }.
2. Give it a new unique rule_id.
3. Choose a check.type that a pass module has registered.
6. Save. No trailing comma after the last rule.

rules.error_message: Melodic augmented second (b6 to raised 7) — double the 3rd of VI to avoid this
Root-position ii7 after tonic in major should omit its 5th to avoid parallel fifths
The roots of successive intermediate harmonies should descend by 5th or 3rd, not ascend
